title: VanillaOverhaul+
description: This modpack overhauls Minecraft in every aspect of the Game while staying true to the Vanilla vibe.
body:
![-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7936690de17ee69763d02b4f0457ee6d8ab3d71.png)

A smooth and _optimized_ Minecraft experience with better visuals, animations, sound and UI — **all while staying true to vanilla charm!**


## Features:


**Optimization** 
- making your game run a lot smoother due to several well-researched optimization mods
 
**Visuals**
-  improving the visuals by adding _Whimscape_ and _Resprited_texture pack, new particles and much more.

**Animations**
- all about making smoother First and 3rd Person Animations!

**Shader**
- Complementary Shader
 
**Visual Effects**
-  just make the damn rain look better :)

**Better Sound**
 - immersive Ambience pairing great with the added music.

**Better Music**
-  needs no explaining, just more Music!!

 **Better UI**
-  Tiny Item Animations, Inventory Sounds and Particles

 **QOL Features**
-  Mouse Tweaks are great:)

 **Flashback Mod**
- make cinematic videos (even as a noob)
